props.animation_script:
// ONI — Acceleration

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][FX][Acceleration]";

// --- Assets ---

const SFX_MOVE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const FX_TARGET = "modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/07-steampunk/clock/Clockwork_Blades_1_1200x1200.webm";

const SFX_TARGET = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Haste.ogg";

// --- Checks ---

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error(`${TAG} Sequencer module is not active.`);

return;

}

function resolveTokenEntry(entry) {

if (!entry) return null;

// TokenDocument -> Token placeable

if (entry?.object) return entry.object;

// Token placeable

if (entry?.center && entry?.document) return entry;

// UUID or token id

if (typeof entry === "string") {

// UUID path

const doc = fromUuidSync?.(entry);

if (doc?.object) return doc.object; // TokenDocument

if (doc?.center && doc?.document) return doc; // Token placeable

if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {

return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

if (doc?.actor?.getActiveTokens) {

return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

// Scene token id fallback

const sceneTok = canvas.tokens?.get?.(entry);

if (sceneTok) return sceneTok;

}

return null;

}

function resolveCasterFromPayload() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const candidates = [

p?.sourceToken,

p?.casterToken,

p?.token,

p?._sourceToken,

p?.meta?.sourceToken,

p?.meta?.casterToken,

p?.action?.sourceToken,

p?.action?.casterToken,

p?.sourceTokenUuid,

p?.casterTokenUuid,

p?.tokenUuid,

p?.tokenUUID,

p?.attackerUuid,

p?.attackerUUID,

p?.meta?.attackerUuid,

p?.meta?.attackerUUID

];

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return null;

}

function resolveTargetsFromPayload() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const out = [];

// Best source: handler already injects normalized targets here

if (Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) {

for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(t);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

}

const arrays = [

p?.targets,

p?.targetTokens,

p?.meta?.targets,

p?.meta?.targetTokens,

p?.targetTokenUuids,

p?.originalTargetUUIDs,

p?.targetTokenIds

].filter(a => Array.isArray(a));

for (const arr of arrays) {

for (const entry of arr) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

}

// Deduplicate

const seen = new Set();

return out.filter(tok => {

const key = tok?.document?.uuid ?? tok?.id;

if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;

seen.add(key);

return true;

});

}

const caster = resolveCasterFromPayload();

if (!caster) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} No caster token found in action payload.`);

return;

}

const targets = resolveTargetsFromPayload();

if (targets.length !== 1) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} Expected exactly 1 target from action payload.`);

return;

}

const target = targets[0];

// --- X-only movement using DOCUMENT coords (top-left) ---

const original = { x: caster.document.x, y: caster.document.y };

const disp = caster.document.disposition;

const squares = 0.35; // tweak distance here

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

// Hostile (-1) => move RIGHT, else => move LEFT

const dx = (disp === -1) ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// IMPORTANT: Y stays EXACTLY original.y

const destOut = { x: original.x + dx, y: original.y };

const destBack = { x: original.x, y: original.y };

// ✅ animation start hook

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { tag: "Acceleration", tokenId: caster.id });

const seq = new Sequence()

// Movement sound

.sound()

.file(SFX_MOVE)

.volume(0.9)

// Move out

.animation()

.on(caster)

.moveTowards(destOut)

.duration(350)

.waitUntilFinished()

// wait 0.5s

.wait(500)

// Target SFX + FX

.sound()

.file(SFX_TARGET)

.volume(0.9)

.effect()

.file(FX_TARGET)

.atLocation(target)

.scaleToObject(2.15)

.anchor({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 })

.opacity(1.0)

.belowTokens(false)

.waitUntilFinished()

// wait 0.5s

.wait(500)

// Move back

.animation()

.on(caster)

.moveTowards(destBack)

.duration(350)

.waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

// Hard guarantee: snap back exactly

if (caster.document.x !== original.x || caster.document.y !== original.y) {

await caster.document.update({ x: original.x, y: original.y });

}

// ✅ animation end hook

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { tag: "Acceleration", tokenId: caster.id });

})();
props.description:
At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose one option:

  • Perform a free attack with a weapon they have equipped

  • Perform the【📕Spell】 action for free, casting a spell with a total MP cost equal to or lower than 10 (paying its MP cost).

After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
